description: This file implements a sandbox filesystem bridge for remote shell operations, including path resolution, file reading/writing, directory creation, removal, renaming, and stat operations, with integration to remote shell scripts and sandbox context.

classes.name: RemoteShellSandboxFsBridge
classes.description: Implements SandboxFsBridge interface for remote sandbox filesystem operations, including path resolution, file manipulation, directory management, and stat.

methods.name: createRemoteShellSandboxFsBridge
methods.description: Factory function to create a sandbox filesystem bridge instance with given sandbox context and runtime handle.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a given file path and optional current working directory to a sandbox resolved path.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Reads a file from the sandbox, returning its contents as a Buffer.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file in the sandbox, creating directories if needed.

methods.name: mkdirp
methods.description: Creates directories in the sandbox path, similar to 'mkdir -p'.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a file or directory from the sandbox, with options for recursive and force removal.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory within the sandbox.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Retrieves file or directory status information from the sandbox.

methods.name: getMounts
methods.description: Determines the current mount points for the sandbox environment.

methods.name: resolveTarget
methods.description: Resolves a given path to a sandbox-specific resolved path, considering mounts and relative paths.

methods.name: toResolvedPath
methods.description: Converts mount and container path info into a resolved sandbox path object.

methods.name: resolveMountByContainerPath
methods.description: Finds the appropriate mount point for a given container path.

methods.name: ensureWritable
methods.description: Checks if a path is writable; throws error if not.

methods.name: remotePathExists
methods.description: Checks if a remote path exists in the sandbox.

methods.name: resolveCanonicalPath
methods.description: Resolves a container path to its canonical form, resolving symlinks.

methods.name: assertNoHardlinkedFile
methods.description: Ensures the file is not hardlinked, to prevent multiple links under sandbox.

methods.name: resolvePinnedParent
methods.description: Resolves the parent directory of a path, ensuring it is within allowed mounts and writable if required.

methods.name: runMutation
methods.description: Runs a mutation command in the sandbox via remote script.

methods.name: runRemoteScript
methods.description: Executes a remote shell script with arguments and input.
